画面与真实世界: The illustration and the real world
画面暂时无法显示，仍可操作控件阅读讲解。: The scene is unavailable. Controls and explanations remain available.
科学互动演示，讲解与操作在画面旁边: Interactive science illustration with explanations and controls alongside
土星的身边不只有光环。认识七颗代表卫星，比较绕行快慢、真实大小和不同的冰雪世界。: Saturn has more than rings. Meet seven representative moons and compare their orbital speeds, true sizes and icy worlds.
选一颗卫星，再切换近景。谁绕得快？谁比别的卫星大得多？: Choose a moon and open its close-up. Which moves fastest? Which is much larger than the others?
选中卫星的公转周期: Orbital period of the selected moon
仅展示七颗代表卫星；轨道距离压缩、天体放大，不是实时位置。拖动可转动。: Seven representative moons only; distances compressed and bodies enlarged, not live positions. Drag to orbit.
光环外面，还有许多卫星绕着土星。这里先认识七颗，并不是土星只有七颗卫星。: Many moons orbit beyond Saturn’s rings. We start with seven; Saturn has many more.
同样过几天，内侧的小卫星已经绕了好几圈，远处的卫星却只走了一小段。: In a few days, inner moons can complete several orbits while a distant moon moves only a short distance.
用菜单选中一颗卫星。切到近景看特点，或切到大小比较，看看谁最大。: Select a moon, then choose a close-up for its features or the size comparison to see which is largest.
有的卫星被冰覆盖，有的有浓厚大气。它们不是七颗一模一样的小球。: Some moons are covered in ice; another has a thick atmosphere. They are very different worlds.
NASA 页面截至 2026 年 8 月列出 293 颗已确认卫星；数量会随发现: NASA lists 293 confirmed moons as of August 2026; the count changes with discoveries and orbital confirmation. Ordinary ring particles are not counted individually as moons.
演示用 JPL 平均公转周期推进圆轨道，相对绕行快慢有依据；距离经过压缩，因此不: Circular orbits advance using JPL mean orbital periods, preserving relative rates. Displayed distances are compressed, so Kepler’s law cannot be inferred from screen distances.
近景颜色与地形为特征示意，不是这些卫星的实测全表面地图。土卫二的喷流强调南极活动: Close-up colors and terrain are feature illustrations, not measured global maps. Enceladus’s plume highlights south-polar activity and is not a fluid simulation.
大小比较只对七颗卫星使用同一半径比例。轨道视图为了可见性放大小天体，两种比例不可: The size comparison applies one radius scale to all seven moons. Small bodies are exaggerated in the orbit view; the two scales must not be mixed.
土卫六有浓厚大气和甲烷、乙烷组成的湖海；土卫二会向太空喷出水汽和冰粒。选择不同卫: Titan has a thick atmosphere and lakes and seas of methane and ethane. Enceladus ejects water vapor and ice grains into space. Select a moon to read its individual card.
本页不是完整卫星目录。采用圆轨道与示意初始位置，忽略摄动、共振细节及食。总数注明: This is not a complete moon catalog. Circular orbits and illustrative starting positions omit perturbations, detailed resonances and eclipses. The count is dated; size comparison and orbit views use different display scales.
表面有一座相对自身非常大的赫歇尔撞击坑。它很小，却不缺醒目的地形。: The Herschel impact crater is very large compared with Mimas itself. This small moon has striking terrain.
明亮冰壳下有全球海洋，南极附近裂隙会喷出水汽和冰粒。喷流也为土星 E 环提供物质: A global ocean lies beneath its bright icy shell. South-polar fractures eject water vapor and ice grains, supplying Saturn’s E ring.
主要由冰组成，表面有大型撞击坑，也有巨大的伊萨卡峡谷系统。: Made mostly of ice, Tethys has large impact craters and the enormous Ithaca Chasma canyon system.
一颗冰质卫星。早期照片中的明亮细纹，后来被看清是与断裂有关的冰崖。: An icy moon whose bright wispy markings were later resolved as ice cliffs associated with fractures.
土星第二大的卫星，表面冰冷而布满撞击坑。它仍远小于土卫六。: Saturn’s second-largest moon has a cold, heavily cratered surface. It is still much smaller than Titan.
土星最大的卫星，比水星直径还大。浓厚大气下有甲烷和乙烷的河流、湖泊与海洋，不是地: Saturn’s largest moon is wider than Mercury. Beneath a thick atmosphere are rivers, lakes and seas of methane and ethane, rather than Earth-like lakes of liquid water.
一侧很暗，另一侧较亮；赤道附近还有醒目的山脊。近景用明暗两区提示这种差异。: One side is very dark and the other much brighter, with a striking equatorial ridge. The close-up uses contrasting regions to suggest this difference.
七颗卫星使用同一半径比例: All seven moons share one radius scale
表面特征示意，不是实测全表面地图: Illustrated features, not measured global maps
卫星大小采用相同比例，间距仅为排版。: Moon sizes share one scale; spacing is for layout only.
放大观察选中的卫星；纹理是特征示意。: An enlarged view of the selected moon; textures illustrate its features.
容易混淆的地方: A distinction to keep in mind
共同中心引力，不同公转周期: One central gravity field, different periods
在卫星质量远小于土星、忽略摄动的近似下，轨道越大，公转周期越长。这里采用 JPL: For moons much less massive than Saturn, neglecting perturbations, larger orbits have longer periods. Seven representative moons advance using JPL mean orbital data. Displayed distances are compressed, while relative rates follow their periods.
T 是公转周期，a 是轨道半长轴，G 为引力常数，M_S 为土星质量。关系式适用: T is orbital period, a semimajor axis, G the gravitational constant and M_S Saturn’s mass. The law uses physical distances, not compressed screen radii.
保持轨道全景播放，比较内侧的土卫一和外侧的土卫八。: Play the orbit view and compare inner Mimas with outer Iapetus.
只展示七颗并不代表只有七颗。卫星确认总数会随发现和轨道复核更新，页面标有来源日期: Showing seven does not mean there are only seven. The confirmed count changes with discoveries and orbit verification; its source is dated.
土卫二约绕行两周，土卫四绕行一周。两者接近 2:1 的平均运动共振能维持土卫二的: Enceladus completes about two orbits for each orbit of Dione. Their near-2:1 mean-motion resonance helps maintain eccentricity, allowing tidal deformation to vary along Enceladus’s orbit. Internal dissipation converts mechanical energy into heat, contributing to the ocean and plume activity.
周期接近整数比是共振的线索；严格判定还需考察共振角的长期行为。当前圆轨道示意不计: A near-integer period ratio is a clue to resonance; a strict diagnosis also examines long-term resonant-angle behavior. The circular display does not calculate eccentricity evolution or heating power.
先选土卫二，再选土卫四，比较公转周期；到土卫二近景找南极喷流。: Select Enceladus and then Dione to compare periods; open Enceladus’s close-up to locate its south-polar plume.
卫星靠得近不等于必然强烈发热；形变周期、内部结构和耗散性质也很重要。: Proximity alone does not ensure strong heating; periodic deformation, interior structure and dissipation also matter.
同属卫星，却是不同世界: Moons can be very different worlds
土卫六的大气以氮为主，表面有甲烷、乙烷组成的液体循环；土卫二的冰壳下有全球性海洋: Titan has a mainly nitrogen atmosphere and a surface liquid cycle involving methane and ethane. Enceladus has a global ocean beneath its ice shell and south-polar fissures that eject water vapor and ice grains. Temperature, gravity, internal heat and composition shape these different environments.
g 是表面重力，v_esc 是逃逸速度，m 和 R 是该卫星的质量与半径。保留大: g is surface gravity, v_esc escape speed, and m and R the moon’s mass and radius. Atmospheric retention also depends on temperature, molecular mass, replenishment and nonthermal escape, not diameter alone.
切换土卫六和土卫二的近景，再读各自的特征卡片。: Switch between Titan and Enceladus close-ups and compare their feature cards.
近景纹理是教学重绘；土卫六画的是朦胧外观，不是穿透大气拍到的地表全景。: Close-up textures are teaching illustrations. Titan’s hazy exterior is not a complete surface view through its atmosphere.
大小比较把七颗卫星放在同一半径尺度。土卫六明显大于其他六颗，但半径比例不能直接当: The size view uses one radius scale for all seven moons. Titan is much larger than the other six, but radius ratios are not mass ratios: volume and mean density also matter. Small moons are exaggerated in the orbit view for visibility.
ρ 为平均密度。若密度相同，半径加倍意味着体积和质量变为八倍；实际卫星的密度并不: ρ is mean density. At equal density, doubling radius multiplies volume and mass by eight; real moons do not all share one density.
切换真实大小比较，找最大的卫星，再选一颗小卫星读它的半径。: Open the true-size view, find the largest moon and select a small one to read its radius.
为排版而留的间距没有天文学含义；不要从这一排球的位置推断轨道。: Spacing in the lineup has no astronomical meaning and does not represent orbital distances.
